title: ConnectionUnavailable payload
description: Connectors answered a retryable operational failure (`kind` `operational`, `next_action` `retry_explicitly`) to every attempt of the run's revalidation of its connection, or of the `connections list` read that resolves a profile-named connection, at most 4 attempts with pauses of 5 s, 10 s and 20 s, before the run fetched any document. Nothing about the source was wrong: the failure is not counted against it, and the next run starts as usual.
